description:
More info @ http://cosmonost.ro/moglebaum

In 2014, violin player Tonio Geugelin joined the band.
This EP "Ozean" describes the fruitful collaboration of the two joung musicians mixing playful beats, vocal-samples and synthesizers with soulful violin sound.
The music is driving but melancholic, surprising and produced with a passion for detail.
